reviews.review_msg: Group project was the hardest part of this class, grading was not super aligned with what was asked of us, exams were pretty straight forward and the MC were pretty similar to the in-class quizzes. I really recommend flash cards for this class and understanding umbrellas theories, the rest falls into place after.
